name: StreetsLA_within_1_Mile_of_LA28_Olympics_SUBJECT_TO_CHANGE
title: StreetsLA within 1 Mile of LA28 Olympics SUBJECT TO CHANGE
snippet: StreetsLA within 1 Mile of the Unofficial LA28 Olympic Venues. This dataset consists of the StreetsLA SECT_IDs that are within 1 Mile radius (buffer) of the proposed LA28 Olympic Venues as points, perimeter, and 1 mile radius buffer polygons. Included are the CurbRamp data from BOE. We can expect some of these streets to get added to programs and projects in preparation for the LA28 Olympics. These geospatial datasets are as we know them today, please consider LA28 Olympic Venues as a draft as of July 2024; these layers are subject to change. Please note: StreetsLA, LADOT, and Sanitation are not authoritative sources of the LA28 Olympic Venues. We default to LA28 Committee when they choose to upload geospatial data. SUBJECT TO CHANGE.
